nodes.name: profile.php
nodes.summary: Shared profile page for any logged-in user: dispatches POST actions to edit name/email/phone, change the password, and upload an avatar, then renders the profile UI in the same file. It is rendered by index.php and depends on the router having already defined $user and $role -- its only guard is an isset() check that redirects to login.php.
nodes.languageNotes: State-changing POST handlers here run with no csrfField()/verifyCsrf() pair, unlike staff.php and settings.php in the same directory. Avatars are MIME-sniffed with finfo and capped at 2MB.

nodes.name: reports.php
nodes.summary: Admin-only reports and analytics module exposing 9 report types (inventory, appointment, payment, sales, loyalty, analytics, evaluation, chatbot, photos) with on-screen tables plus PDF and CSV export. Revenue is derived from actual paid payments rather than booking totals, and the analytics report computes genuine period-over-period deltas instead of hard-coded percentages.
nodes.languageNotes: Helpers are wrapped in if (!function_exists(...)) guards and the FPDF subclass sits inside a runtime if ($fpdfLoaded) block, so conditional declarations are invisible to static parsers. FPDF itself is hand-vendored under includes/fpdf/, not installed via Composer.

nodes.name: sales.php
nodes.summary: Admin sales ledger that filters the payments table by date range, status, payment method and free-text search, then derives summary cards plus daily-revenue, per-package and per-method breakdowns for charting. The transaction query, metric aggregates and chart queries all reuse the same WHERE clause so the summary cards always match the table below them.

nodes.name: settings.php
nodes.summary: Admin-only settings screen that persists studio identity, opening hours and GCash/Maribank account details into the settings key/value table and handles QR-code image uploads. Every text field is written with INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, and each QR upload is MIME-sniffed, capped at 5MB and has its predecessor file deleted.
nodes.languageNotes: Uploads land in uploads/payment/ rather than the UPLOAD_DIR constant (assets/uploads/), one of the six scattered upload roots in this project.

nodes.name: staff.php
nodes.summary: Admin page for managing staff accounts: adds a user with the staff role, flips is_active, and deletes staff rows via a CSRF-checked POST handler that redirects back to index.php?page=staff. The listing pulls every staff user together with a count of the bookings each one managed.

nodes.name: chatbot-ai.php
nodes.summary: Standalone SnapBot AI JSON endpoint for the public booking site that runs a three-stage cascade: live availability answered from the bookings table, then a hard-coded Studio 94 FAQ, then a Gemini generateContent call across a four-model fallback chain. Every reply is persisted to chat_history and markdown is stripped before the JSON response is emitted.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on a POST endpoint with no authentication, and hard-codes prices, hours and policies into the Gemini system prompt instead of reading the packages/settings tables -- so the chatbot and the database can disagree.

nodes.name: check-client-loyalty.php
nodes.summary: Standalone staff/admin JSON endpoint that resolves a client by phone or email and returns their loyalty booking count, bonus minutes, discount percentage and tier label for the booking form. The tier thresholds are duplicated inline rather than delegated to getLoyaltyTier() in functions.php, so the two definitions can drift apart.
nodes.languageNotes: Returns the raw $e->getMessage() text in the JSON error payload, which leaks database error detail to the caller.

nodes.name: check_availability.php
nodes.summary: Standalone staff/admin JSON endpoint that builds a 15-minute slot grid between 10:00 AM and 7:00 PM for a given date and package, adding a capped loyalty bonus to the package duration. Slots carry a three-state result -- available, pending approval, or fully booked -- with confirmed bookings taking priority over awaiting-approval ones.
nodes.languageNotes: Package length is recovered from a free-text duration column by regex (extractMinutesFromDuration) rather than stored as minutes, so an unfamiliar duration string silently falls back to 60.

nodes.name: getReportData
nodes.summary: Single 700-line switch that runs the SQL for each of the 9 report types and returns the row set plus per-report flags. The analytics branch additionally loads the equivalent previous period so real change percentages can be computed.

nodes.name: generateReportPDF
nodes.summary: Renders any of the 9 reports into a paginated PDF via the Studio94ReportPDF subclass, with per-report column widths, a filled table header, type-specific row formatting and alternating row shading.

nodes.name: reportStatusBadge
nodes.summary: Maps a status string onto the green/amber/red/gray badge classes used across every report table, covering payment, booking, inventory and equipment condition vocabularies.

nodes.name: reportDate
nodes.summary: Formats a database date as 'Mon DD, YYYY', rendering an em dash for empty values and falling back to the escaped raw string when it cannot be parsed.

nodes.name: validReportDate
nodes.summary: Strict Y-m-d validator built on DateTime::createFromFormat with a round-trip format comparison, used to reject tampered from/to query parameters before they reach SQL.

nodes.name: Studio94ReportPDF
nodes.summary: FPDF subclass that transcodes UTF-8 text to windows-1252 with //TRANSLIT//IGNORE before writing cells, which is what lets peso signs and accented characters survive PDF export. Declared conditionally inside if ($fpdfLoaded).

nodes.name: salesStatusClass
nodes.summary: Returns the success/warning/danger/neutral CSS class for a payment status, bucketing PAID/VERIFIED/COMPLETED as green and REJECTED/FAILED/CANCELLED as red.

nodes.name: salesStatusLabel
nodes.summary: Maps a payment status onto an emoji-prefixed human label such as 'AWAITING PAYMENT', passing unknown statuses through unchanged instead of hiding them.

nodes.name: handleQrUpload
nodes.summary: Validates a GCash/Maribank QR upload via finfo MIME sniffing, writes it to uploads/payment/ with a random-suffixed filename, upserts the stored path into settings, and unlinks the replaced file.

nodes.name: cleanBotText
nodes.summary: Strips code fences, bold/italic markers and backticks from a Gemini reply, converts markdown bullets to the bullet character, collapses runs of blank lines and trims per-line whitespace so the text is safe to inject into the chat widget.

nodes.name: saveChatLog
nodes.summary: Inserts the user message and bot reply into chat_history, falling back to user id 1 for anonymous visitors and swallowing any database error to error_log so logging can never break a chat reply.

nodes.name: isAvailabilityQuestion
nodes.summary: Regex gate that decides whether a normalized user message is asking about booking availability, checking English and Filipino/Tagalog phrasings ('may slot ba', 'available ba sa') so the chatbot answers from the database instead of hallucinating.

nodes.name: parseRequestedDate
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested date from natural language -- today/tomorrow, weekday names, explicit month-day or ISO dates, and plain 'the 26th' -- returning a Manila-timezone DateTime or null to trigger a clarifying prompt.

nodes.name: parseRequestedTime
nodes.summary: Extracts an optional requested start time such as '2pm' or '14:00' from the user message so the availability answer can focus on that slot.

nodes.name: getBookingsForDate
nodes.summary: Loads all non-cancelled, non-rejected bookings for a date joined to their package duration, returning normalised start/end minute intervals used for overlap checks.

nodes.name: mergeSlots
nodes.summary: Collapses overlapping or contiguous free intervals into a minimal set of bookable windows so the chatbot reports genuinely open stretches rather than a slot-by-slot list.

nodes.name: buildAvailabilityResponse
nodes.summary: Turns a date plus its bookings into the conversational English answer, reporting free windows, flagging dates that are fully booked and calling out when every remaining slot is still awaiting approval.

nodes.name: answerFAQ
nodes.summary: Regex-matched FAQ covering packages, prices, hours, location, GCash payment and the non-refundable cancellation policy, returning null when nothing matches so the request falls through to the Gemini fallback.

nodes.name: callGemini
nodes.summary: Posts a system-instruction-separated payload to the Gemini generateContent endpoint via cURL, iterating the model fallback chain, logging each failure and surfacing the finish_reason so truncated answers can be detected. Disables SSL peer verification, which is a real MITM risk for an API carrying the Gemini key.
